# Saving Arrows

> Saving Arrows is a nonprofit anti-trafficking organization and structured day program providing equestrian therapy, trauma-informed care, and licensed clinical treatment for children under 18 who have survived trafficking, exploitation, and complex trauma. Operated by Liberators Alliance, based on a 40-acre farm in Castle Rock, Colorado.

Saving Arrows is a program of Liberators Alliance, an organization with over five years of operational history building clinical and organizational frameworks for trauma-informed aftercare. Liberators Alliance is establishing national headquarters in Denver, Colorado.

The program is designed for child survivors of sex trafficking, labor trafficking, and exploitation who benefit from a trauma-informed alternative to traditional interventions. Participants attend as a day program, returning home or to their placement each evening — preserving family and community connections while receiving intensive clinical care.

## Mission

To provide clinically rigorous, trauma-informed healing for child survivors of trafficking and trauma through an integrated model of equestrian therapy, evidence-based clinical treatment, and a purpose-built healing environment.

Tagline: "Restoring direction. Rebuilding futures."

## Program Components

- Equestrian-assisted therapy (EAT/EAP): Evidence-informed interaction with horses that builds emotional regulation, trust, and self-efficacy for trauma survivors. Credentialed under PATH Intl. and EAGALA standards.
- Trauma-Informed Care (TIC): Organizational and relational framework based on SAMHSA's six principles — safety, trustworthiness, peer support, collaboration, empowerment, and cultural humility.
- Clinical treatment: Licensed therapists providing Trauma-Focused CBT (TF-CBT), EMDR, and somatic approaches individualized to each participant.

## Who Is Served

Children and adolescents under 18 years of age who are survivors of:
- Sex trafficking or commercial sexual exploitation
- Labor trafficking or other forms of exploitation
- Complex trauma or repeated/prolonged trauma histories
- Referred by schools, foster care, juvenile courts, child advocacy centers, law enforcement, or community organizations

- [Partner With Us](https://conus.liberators-alliance.org/partner/): Partnership opportunities for licensed clinicians, equine-assisted therapy practitioners, community organizations, and researchers.

## Key Facts

- Organization type: Nonprofit anti-trafficking organization (NGO)
- Program type: Structured day program; not residential
- Location: Castle Rock, Colorado (40-acre farm)
- National headquarters: Denver, Colorado
- Population served: Children under 18, survivors of trafficking and complex trauma
- Contact: contactus@liberators-alliance.org
- Website: https://conus.liberators-alliance.org
- Parent organization: Liberators Alliance (https://liberators-alliance.org)

## How to Help

- Donate: Visit https://conus.liberators-alliance.org/donate/

- Partner with us: Email contactus@liberators-alliance.org with subject "Partnership Inquiry"
- Share the mission: Share https://conus.liberators-alliance.org on social media
